previouslyOwned._provenance: PREVIOUSLY OWNED — every company the family held directly, through a PMS mandate or through an AIF and now holds none of, with the date it last held it. Derived by scripts/lib/previously-owned.mjs from the dated trades and capital-gain lots in book-ledger.json and the nil-balance funds in the generated book, both read from techmuns/GlowVentures. A company is listed only where every account that traded it confirms the zero — a holdings statement dated after its last trade, a tape that liquidates the mandate, or a nil balance; the rest are named under unconfirmed. The tape is the statements’ window, so a company sold before it began is not here. No quantity, cost or value.
